snippet_primary: "I bought something from a seller and noticed that not only was it not handmade but it was cheap and came from a company in China. The owner tried to say that he only made the wooden bases for these cheap lights that one had to glue together but he lied about that too & made an excuse, saying he had run out & had to order it from his supplier in China. I supplied proof to Etsy when I reported the shop owner along with pictures, the packaging from China, etc. & Etsy did nothing about it."
